scope: Source-backed additions and corrections to the earlier inventory. This is not a complete inventory of pstack. Earlier verified labels are not inherited.

behaviors.feature: Shell subagent supplied by Cursor host
behaviors.purpose: Execute terminal commands, including the shell delegate named by cursor-team-kit code-quality review.
behaviors.trigger: Task with subagent_type shell when the host enables the shell subagent.
behaviors.preconditions: Desktop Jle receives includeShellSubagent true. A usable model and shell are required. The live account's feature-flag value has not been observed.
behaviors.source: cursor-team-kit/agents/thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review.md at bb68f2365eceafa0cb2d253112f675acf5f144cc; Cursor desktop 3.27.22 Jle, Mle, Ple in evidence/desktop-agent-definitions.txt; source hashes and offsets in baseline.json.
behaviors.inputs: Task description, prompt, model, execution mode, and readonly constraints. Type lookup normalization is specified separately.
behaviors.stateTransitions: Resolve shell definition; retain SHELL tools only; remove Task and AskQuestion; inject the command specialist reminder; execute the child; return its final result or failure through Task.
behaviors.outputs: Shell output and shell side effects. Background execution is part of SHELL. AWAIT is a different identifier and is not retained.
behaviors.errors: Shell command failures reach the child. Child failures, cancellation, and resume use the ordinary Task lifecycle. The specialized role is not itself a readonly sandbox.
behaviors.executionModes: The source-defined desktop role is feature-gated. Earlier CLI absence does not establish desktop absence. Pi TUI, JSON, and RPC execution need verification.
behaviors.cursorMechanism: Host-provided subagent definition, system reminder, and enforced tool filtering.
behaviors.piEquivalent: A shell AgentDefinition with an exact native bash and bash_background tool list, no Task, and no MCP. Readonly intersects this list with existing sandboxed tools.
behaviors.existingPiBehavior: The initial implementation rejects shell as an unknown type.
behaviors.divergence: Missing shell role and enforced shell-only tool selection.
verification: probe-reference.mjs executes original source definitions and filters
test/e2e/shell-agent.e2e.test.ts exercises real Pi with deterministic model output
behaviors.status: implementation pending; reference function probes passed; Pi baseline pending

behaviors.purpose: Resolve supported type spellings without rejecting case, separators, or a role suffix.
behaviors.trigger: Task resolves a subagent_type against available definitions.
behaviors.preconditions: The canonical type is in the host definition list.
behaviors.source: Cursor desktop 3.27.22 Fle, Ule, and Wle in evidence/desktop-agent-definitions.txt; source hashes and offsets in baseline.json.
dependencyCallChain: Fle for requested and available type names
behaviors.inputs: A type string. Trim; lowercase; remove hyphens and underscores; remove one trailing subagenttype, subagent, agent, mode, or type when a prefix remains. Mediareview normalizes to videoreview.
behaviors.stateTransitions: Normalize the request and each definition, then select the first match.
behaviors.outputs: The canonical matching definition, or no match.
behaviors.errors: Unknown types remain unknown. Normalization does not create an unavailable role.
behaviors.executionModes: A pure lookup used by the desktop host. Not dependent on UI interaction.
behaviors.piEquivalent: Normalize at findAgent, not by changing recorded canonical type names.
behaviors.divergence: Requests such as SHELL, shell_agent, and shell-subagent-type fail.
behaviors.status: implementation pending; reference function probes passed

behaviors.feature: Command references throughout a submitted message
behaviors.purpose: Attach command instructions and arguments without requiring the command to start the message.
behaviors.trigger: Cursor CLI submission calls findCommandReferences on the whole message.
behaviors.preconditions: The command is loaded in CustomCommandsManager.commands. Skill references use a separate map and scanner.
behaviors.source: Cursor CLI 2026.10.22-27dcf5f, 1623.index.js custom-commands.ts in evidence/cli-custom-commands.txt; submission call sites in 7000.index.js were inspected earlier in this run.
behaviors.inputs: The scanner accepts slash names at the start or after whitespace. It consumes horizontal arguments through the next newline. Lookup is case-sensitive. Successful references deduplicate by lowercase ID. Arguments split on whitespace without quote handling.
behaviors.stateTransitions: Scan original text once; resolve each match; split its arguments; construct command records in first-reference order. A second slash on the same line can be consumed as an argument rather than another command.
behaviors.outputs: Command records with name, expanded content, and fullPath. The original user message remains distinct from attached context.
behaviors.errors: Unknown commands are ignored. Missing placeholders become empty strings. No command execution occurs merely from a reference scan.
behaviors.executionModes: Interactive and headless CLI submission use the scanner.
behaviors.piEquivalent: A Pi-native context attachment for command references. Existing Pi prompt-template semantics must not silently be changed for unrelated user templates.
behaviors.existingPiBehavior: Only a leading Pi prompt template expands. The alias adapter duplicates Pi's quoted-argument expansion when a template and skill coexist.
behaviors.divergence: References in prose and later lines do not attach commands. Cursor and Pi argument expansion differ. No dedicated Cursor command resource is currently shipped by pstack.
verification: probe-reference.mjs executes the original scanner and expander
